verdict.rationale: Both changes have identical production code: they add STUDENT to the enum, take the max of the student and loyalty rates in DiscountPolicy, and add the receipt label. A adds a receipt test for the new label and the discount line, and keeps the silver and gold cases as separate, well-named tests. A's report is accurate, including the test count. B's report contains a garbled reference to 'crapper, dryer or mutator tools' that don't exist in this repo, and mentions an unrequested commit.

b_issues: No test covers the new 'student' receipt label.
The report has a garbled sentence about running 'crapper, dryer or mutator tools  calls for', which this repo doesn't have.
The report says the change was committed to main, which wasn't requested.
The silver case is folded into the generic studentsGetTenPercent test instead of being named as the max-of-two edge case.
